mapper.insert: INSERT INTO router_prefix_history ( api_key_id, model_alias, prefix_hash, channel, last_success_at, expires_at) VALUES ( #{apiKeyId}, #{modelAlias}, #{prefixHash}, #{channel}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_success_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), expires_at = DATE_ADD( CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND )
